title: Deposit product created
description: Create an organization's time deposit accounts. The Create deposit product endpoint generates this event.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Product ID in the pismo platform. UUID v4 format.

name.title: Product name
name.description: Name given to the product by the customer.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest plan ID
interest_plan_id.description: Interest plan ID in the pismo platform. UUID v4 format.

term_type.title: Term type
term_type.description: Type of term used for the deposit product. Can be `FIXED` or `FLEXIBLE`.

status.title: Status
status.description: Deposit product status. A new product's status is always "CREATED".

created_at.title: Creation datetime
created_at.description: Deposit product creation datetime. Represented as an RFC3339 timestamp.

cool_off_period.title: Cool off period
cool_off_period.description: Period to withdraw without a fine being applied, in days.

funding_duration.title: Funding duration
funding_duration.description: Period to deposit funds into the account before operations are blocked, in days.

updated_at.title: Update datetime
updated_at.description: Deposit product last update datetime. Represented as an RFC3339 timestamp.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Deposit product start date. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: Deposit product end date. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

maturity_instructions.title: Maturity instructions
maturity_instructions.description: Instructions for what to do with funds once maturity date is reached

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: How principal (initial investment) funds  are processed once the maturity date is reached. This can be either `NO_ACTION` or `ROLLOVER`

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: How interest funds are processed once the maturity date is reached. This can be either `PAY` or `ROLLOVER`

penalties.title: Penalties
penalties.description: Defines penalties that apply for early withdrawals or other conditions

tiered_interest_forfeiture.title: Tiered interest forfeiture
tiered_interest_forfeiture.description: Defines tiered interest forfeiture based on how many days the deposit was held in the account

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: How many days after a withdrawal a new withdrawal is treated as penalty-eligible.

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as the penalty amount.

window_behavior.title: Window behavior
window_behavior.description: Controls how the penalty window behaves after each withdrawal.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Maturity notices configured for the product.

days_before_maturity.title: Days before maturity
days_before_maturity.description: Number of days before maturity when the notice is emitted.

early_withdrawal_after_opening.title: Early withdrawal after opening
early_withdrawal_after_opening.description: Penalty structure for early withdrawal after opening an account

applicable_within_days.title: Days when penalty applies
applicable_within_days.description: Number of days after opening when the penalty applies

penalty_interest_days.title: Days for interest penalty
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to calculate forfeiture penalty

grace_period.title: Grace period
grace_period.description: Defines grace period for withdrawal penalties

duration_days.title: Days of grace period
duration_days.description: Duration of the grace period in days

penalty_interest_days.title: Days of interest penalty
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to calculate forfeiture penalty

tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.title: Interest forfeiture tier definition
tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.description: Defines tiers of interest forfeiture based on deposit holding period

min_days_held.title: Minimum days held
min_days_held.description: Minimum number of days the deposit must be held

max_days_held.title: Maximum days held
max_days_held.description: Maximum number of days the deposit can be held

forfeited_interest_days.title: Days to calculate forfeited interest
forfeited_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty
